faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Find quick answers to common questions about our technology services and support.

questions.question: What is UPTTIK UMB?
questions.answer: UPTTIK (Technical Implementation Unit of Information and Communication Technology) is a work unit at the University of Muhammadiyah Bengkulu responsible for managing IT infrastructure, information systems, and technology services within the campus.

questions.question: What services are provided by UPTTIK?
questions.answer: We provide various services including campus internet network management, website & academic information system development, hardware maintenance, and technical support (IT Support) for the entire academic community.

questions.question: How to get help if there are IT issues?
questions.answer: You can contact us via WhatsApp through the button in the contact, or visit the UPTTIK UMB office during working hours.

questions.question: Are UPTTIK services available for students?
questions.answer: Yes, the entire academic community including students, lecturers, and staff are entitled to receive technology services and support from UPTTIK for academic and administrative purposes.

questions.question: Where is the UPTTIK UMB office located?
questions.answer: The UPTTIK office is located at Jl. Bali, Komplek Universitas Muhammadiyah Gedung D, Kampung Bali, Bengkulu.

questions.question: What are UPTTIK's operational hours?
questions.answer: UPTTIK services are available every working day (Monday - Saturday) from 08.00 AM to 02.00 PM. For emergency assistance outside working hours, you can leave a message through our WhatsApp support.
